Screen-Size-Changing Chip There are two chips; “NARROW" (Standard Size) and “WIDE"™ (Larger Size). Normally, set to the “NARROW".
Screen-Inversion Connectors There are two connectors; "NORMAL"(Standard) and “REVERSE" (Screen-Inversion). Normally, set to the "NORMAL" .

SCREEN This is to be set to the “cut-off" point. Normally, this control is not used.
The distance to the criminal's car is displayed on the right part of the screen and the damage of the criminal's car is displayed on the left part of the screen.

When the turbo switch is pressed, the player's car is explosively accelerated by the turbo power for a given tin (The number of turbo-usable times is displayed on the low left part of the screen, end this number is reset every time when each stage is cleared. Note that the remaining number of turbos in the previous stage is not added to that for the next stage.)
The game ends when the time reaches "OQ", or. 5 stages have been cleared. .

When the game is over, if the score is ranked in the 10th place or higher, the name registration can be made. (In this case, select letters by using the steering wheel, and register them by using the accelerator or the turbo switch.)
